scholarships.name: Study Scholarships - Postgraduate Studies in the Field of the Performing Arts **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: This scholarship programme offers you the opportunity to continue your education in Germany with a postgraduate or continuing course of study. The scholarships also promote the exchange of experience and networking amongst colleagues.
scholarships.deadlineText: Application deadlines are updated at least once a year. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year. You can find the current dates here:
scholarships.sourceQuote: You can apply if you have gained a first university degree in the field of the Performing Arts at the latest by the time you commence your scholarship-supported study programme.

eligibility.sourceQuote: Your application cannot be considered, if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

eligibility.textValue: knowledge of the language of instruction required by the chosen university by the start of the scholarship
eligibility.sourceQuote: You should have the knowledge of the language of instruction which corresponds to the requirements of the chosen university at the latest by the time you start the scholarship.
